title: Schedule of Estimate Uplifts for Accounts with Earlier Estimated Assessments
content:
On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, the uplift applied in an estimated assessment follows the estimated assessments already booked on the account within the estimate history months, 24.

| Estimated assessments already booked on the account within 24 months | Uplift |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 2.0 |
| Exactly one | 1.5 |
| None | The class's estimated assessment uplift |

**Counting.** The 24-month window is counted in whole months back from the day the new estimate is booked, by the entry dates of the earlier estimated assessments in the account's balance history. Only contribution assessments that rest on an estimate are counted; assessments booked from filed or amended reports are not. The estimate being booked is not one of those already booked.

## Notes to the schedule (hypothetical accounts)

- An account with estimated assessments booked 5 months and 19 months before the new estimate has two within 24 months: uplift 2.0.
- An account with one estimated assessment booked 11 months before: uplift 1.5.
- An account whose only earlier estimated assessment was booked 30 months before has none within 24 months: the uplift is the class's estimated assessment uplift.
- The step between the rows: one earlier estimate gives 1.5; a second one within the window moves the account to 2.0.
